sections.description:
GILGIT-BALTISTAN COUNCIL CIVIL SERVANTS
GILGIT-BALTISTAN COUNCIL
CIVIL SERVANTS
(APPOINTMENT, PROMOTIN AND
TRANSFER)
(ADAPTATION) RULES, 2010
(Addition of proviso to
R.14)
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II,
20th January, 2012]
S.R.O.48(I)/2012,
dated 12-1-2012.---In exercise of powers conferred under section 25 of the
Civil Servants Act, 1973 as adapted under Gilgit-Baltistan Council Civil
Servants (Adaptation) Act, 2010, the Gilgit-Baltistan Council is pleased to
make the following amendment in Rule 14 of Gilgit-Baltistan Council Civil
Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) (Adaptation) Rules, 2010 by
adding a proviso therein:
"Provided
that 50% vacancies in BS-3 to 15 will be filled by appointment of persons
domiciled in Gilgit-Baltistan".
